author: Mark Atwood
text:
Trait-signature API break — needs explicit owner approval.

The bead recommends widening fn compute_task_utc_times to async to match canonical sibling jmap-calendars-server (which has the analog as async). The current sync shape forces backends doing tzdata lookup in-process to either embed the dataset (binary size hit) or block the runtime (correctness hit on tokio). Calendar's analog dodged both.

Recommendation: option (a) widen to async, matching canonical sibling shape. Rationale: workspace canonical-template propagation rule says siblings must mirror canonical idiom; the sync shape here was wrong from day one. Cost is one .await on every call site (currently zero non-test sites because the default impl returns (None, None)).

Alternative: option (b) keep sync, add a separate async fn compute_task_utc_times_async with a default impl that calls the sync version. This is an additive non-breaking change but bakes in the wrong shape permanently.

Pre-publish crate; favoring (a) for canonical parity. Escalating because it's a trait-signature API break that hasn't been explicitly authorised.
